data.name: Bandos FPV
data.detailed_description:
FLY TOGETHER. FLY REAL.

Bandos FPV is a multiplayer drone sim built for the way people actually fly — with friends, in voice chat, sharing the line. Whether you're a real-world pilot who wants somewhere to keep your thumbs sharp or you've never touched a transmitter in your life, the same drones are waiting for you. The difference is just how much help you want.

━━━ THREE MODES, ONE DRONE ━━━

- ANGLE — Self-leveling. The sticks point the drone where you want to look. Let go, and the drone returns to level. This is how a Mavic flies.

- HORIZON — Self-levels near center, lets you flip when you slam the sticks. The honest middle ground.

- ACRO — Pure rate control. The drone holds whatever angle you put it at. This is real FPV. Crashes, sweat, the works.

Layer on independent assists when you want them: Air Mode for control on zero-throttle dives, Altitude Hold for cinematic shots, Position Hold for hovering steady, Turtle Mode for flipping back upright after the inevitable.

━━━ HARDWARE THAT FEELS REAL ━━━

Every drone in Bandos has real specs driving real behavior. Battery cells, motor KV, prop pitch, mass, thrust-to-weight — these aren't cosmetic numbers on a spec sheet. They shape how the drone flies.

- REAL LIPO BATTERIES — Punch the throttle and voltage sags. Drain the pack, and your motors get weaker. Run it empty, and you wallow out of the sky.  Land on a recharge pad to get back in the fight.

- TUNES YOU CAN CYCLE IN-FLIGHT — Each drone ships with multiple Betaflight- style tunes. Smooth for cruising. Aggressive for tricks. Race-tuned for speed. Cycle between them mid-air the same way you would in real life.

- AUTHENTIC FEEL ACROSS DEVICES — Native support for radio transmitters,  gamepads, and keyboard. Tune the expo, rates, and stick smoothing per drone.

━━━ MULTIPLAYER FIRST ━━━

- VOICE CHAT — Talk while you fly. The whole point.

- SHARED FREESTYLE — Drop into a server, find a friend, find a building, see what happens.

- MATCH MODES — Freestyle session, timed matches, racing, and cinematic modes.

━━━ THE ROADMAP ━━━

Bandos is built to grow with its community. Here's what's coming:

- RACING — Gates, lap times, leaderboards.

- CINEMATIC / PHOTO MODE — Capture footage, share screenshots, get the shot.

- TUNE SHARING — Upload your favorite tune and let others fly it.

- MAP BUILDER — Build your own freestyle spots and race courses. Share them.

- MORE DRONES — Cinewhoops, long-range rigs, micro builds.

If you fly real drones, this is your indoor track for the rainy days. If you've never flown one, this is how you find out whether you want to. Either way, there's a stick waiting and a friend in voice chat.

See you in the sky.

data.short_description: Fly real-feel FPV drones with friends. Realistic physics, three flight modes, and tunable hardware — from training-wheel Angle mode to full Acro. Freestyle, racing, and cinematic modes. Voice chat, multiplayer matches, and a creator-driven future. Bring your stick — or your keyboard.
